title: exec arguments (server "exec", tool "exec")
description: The arguments of mcp-exec's exec tool (ExecRequest in src/service.rs of github.com/r33drichards/mcp-exec, at the commit images/browser/flake.lock pins), which is input.arguments of the mcp_tools policy input when input.server is "exec" and input.tool is "exec". The server refuses anything that does not match (unknown fields included), but a policy is asked BEFORE the server parses anything: in a policy every field can be missing or of any type, and other fields can be present. images/browser/test/exec-smoke.mjs checks these properties against the packaged server.

bin.description: The program, executed directly (no shell). Without a "/" it is a name looked up on PATH (the desktop's, unless env sets PATH); with one it is that path, relative to cwd when it is not absolute.

args.description: The program's arguments, passed exactly as given: no word splitting, globbing or expansion. Absent means none.

timeout.description: Seconds (not milliseconds) after which the program and everything it started (its process group) are killed and the status becomes "timeout". No default and no maximum in the server.

cwd.description: Working directory: an absolute path to an existing directory. The server does not normalise it or resolve symbolic links. Absent: the desktop user's home directory.

env.description: Variables added to the desktop's environment. Any name is accepted (not empty, no "="), PATH and LD_PRELOAD included.
